title: Feature Removed - Customer Workflow Broken Without Notice
agent_context: Customer’s workflow is disrupted due to a removed/deprecated feature with no prior notice. Acknowledge impact, explain the product change at a high level, offer workarounds, and escalate to migration/product support with a follow-up plan.

raw_content.initial_message: We logged in today and the automation rules feature is just gone. That’s not a minor change — we’ve built our entire internal workflow around those rules. There was no warning, no migration guide, nothing. Right now my team is manually doing work that used to be automated, and it’s already causing delays. What happened, and what are you going to do to help us get back to normal?
raw_content.context: Feature deprecated/removed. Customer workflow impacted; expects notice and migration support. Policy: do not argue; acknowledge impact; provide high-level explanation of product change; offer available alternatives/workarounds; route to product/migrations team; set follow-up plan and cadence; avoid promising feature return unless confirmed.

learning_objectives: Communicate product changes empathetically and clearly
Offer realistic alternatives and mitigation steps
Escalate to the correct team for migration support
correct_sop_steps: Acknowledge impact and apologize for disruption
Clarify which workflow depends on the removed feature and what their critical path is today
Explain at a high level that the feature has been deprecated/changed and you’ll confirm the official notice/details
Offer immediate mitigations: alternative feature, manual workaround checklist, or temporary configuration support if available
Escalate to product/migrations team (or account owner) for migration guidance and timeline
Set next update time and a follow-up support plan
common_mistakes: Minimizing the impact ('it’s a small change')
Arguing about whether notice was sent

must_demonstrate: Provides at least one realistic workaround/alternative
Escalates to migration/product support with timeline/cadence
bonus_points: Provides a short step-by-step workaround checklist
Offers to schedule a migration support call or guided session
sticky_notes: KEY: They need help operating today—workaround first, explanation second.
TRAP: Don’t promise reinstatement unless confirmed by product.
HINT: Ask what the automation rules were doing so you can map them to alternatives.

customer_persona_hints.starting_tone: Frustrated, operationally impacted, not emotional ranting
customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Customer calms down if you provide a practical workaround for today and a clear migration support path with an update cadence
